title: Carl Sagan as a Majestic member
summary: Jason Jorjani tells of Carl Sagan as a Majestic member, about 1960s-1970s at United States (no place named), and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: I'm pretty convinced Sean was a member of Majestic.

plain: Jason Jorjani, a philosopher, said on Jesse Michels's podcast that he is pretty convinced the astronomer and science writer Carl Sagan was a member of Majestic, a group said to be a secret panel that oversees what the government knows about UFOs. If true, it would mean one of the best known public voices of science was quietly part of the inner circle.
